changelog:
v4.1.0 Critical Bug Fixes:
• Fixed Lock Mode inconsistently blocking touches (stale FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE bits never cleared).
• Fixed hiding toggle deactivating blockage zones (pill visibility now 100% decoupled from zone blocking).
• Fixed zones not activating on service start when foreground package unknown.
• Rebuilt window flags from scratch every refresh cycle to prevent stale state accumulation.
